A '''planet''' existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was [[Homeworld|home]] to be populated with many dangerous creatures. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] which had begun by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had set up a base on this [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The surrounding area was made up of [[ocean]]s and swamps.<ref name="Creature Comfort" />
